name: @ship/skills
description: Ship Skills pack — <ship-skill-list>, <ship-skill-detail>. The hub /studio/skills surface; reads the Connect SDK (ship.skills.list / ship.skills.detail) and composes <sui-stack> / <sui-card> / <sui-empty-state> / <sui-spinner> / <sui-icon> / <sui-badge> / <sui-cluster> / <sui-button> / <sui-skeleton> from @ship/sui-primitives. The list is grouped by SkillScopeTag (project/user); the detail page renders frontmatter, body, and files. Wired by `apps/hub/routes/studio/skills/`. Reuses the existing per-package `deck.bundles` self-declaration (the framework discovers it the same way as `@ship/home` and `@ship/studio`).
